verification_report.summary: Correct. The cited proof's edge-PML construction matches the source alpha=1 Maxwell-PML equations. For constant sigma_x=s>0, sigma_y=0, the ansatz E=P=P_{z,1}=P_{z,2}=H_y=Q_y=0 with spatially constant H_x,Q_x satisfies the electric equation, the alpha=1 polarization law, the P_z equations, the H_y/Q_y equations, and PEC. The remaining source equations reduce to H_{x,t}=bH_x+Q_x/mu and Q_{x,t}=-bQ_x-mu b^2H_x with b=s/epsilon_0, so M_x=Q_x+mu bH_x is conserved and nonzero M_x gives linear growth of H_x and Q_x. The symmetric sigma_x=0, sigma_y=s>0 construction gives the same conclusion for H_y,Q_y. Since these are exact finite-energy solutions whose displayed magnetic/auxiliary variables grow linearly, any time-independent positive coercive energy controlling the displayed variables cannot be monotone decreasing or uniformly long-time bounded for all source-system data in the edge-PML regime. The predecessor alpha=1 algebra-balance fact is verified and agrees with the source equations.
